summary: CR-046 Control Dashboard v2.0 — Full QA pass of Phase 1 (login + build exclusion) and Phase 2 (gate progress bars, stage filter, multi-select, batch queue, Gate 4 approval buttons, smoke buttons, queue panel). All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Phase 1 Login: Login screen appears correctly with username/password fields. Wrong credentials show 'Invalid username or password' error. Correct credentials (abhishek jain / Qplazm@07111981) load dashboard with all tabs.
Phase 1 Session: Session persists in sessionStorage after page refresh. Dashboard loads without re-login.
Phase 1 Build Exclusion: 'yarn build' completes successfully. 'ls build/__dev/' returns error (directory does NOT exist in production build). CR-046 hook in craco.config.js working correctly.
Phase 2 Gate Progress Bar: CR Registry tab shows gate indicators (Intake→Plan→Gate4→Code→QA→Smoke) with colored status icons (✅⬜🟡🔴). CLOSED items show all green. POS 5.0 items show partial progress.
Phase 2 Stage Filter: 'All Stages' dropdown works. Selecting 'Ready for: Planning' filters to eligible items only.
Phase 2 Multi-select: Checkboxes appear on each CR row. Header checkbox selects all visible. Individual checkboxes toggle. Selected count shows in bottom action bar.
Phase 2 Batch Action Bar: When items selected + stage filter set, sticky bottom bar shows '{N} items selected' + 'Send to {Stage}' button + '+ add notes' link.
Phase 2 Queue Panel: Workflow Queue panel shows active batches, completed batches, recent approvals, recent smoke results. 'Export JSON' and 'Refresh' buttons present.
Phase 2 Gate 4 Buttons: Gate 4 GO/NO buttons present in ACTIONS column for eligible items.

Existing tabs: Closure Debt tab loads (0 active debt, 66 archived, 98 all-time tracked). Bug Tracker tab loads with 16/141 badge and all KPIs (141 total, 119 closed, 4 open intake, 8 backend-blocked). CR Registry tab loads with 3/64 badge (3 active, 57 shipped, 64 total).
Regression: POS app at main URL loads normally with MyGenie login page. Dashboard changes did NOT affect the POS application.
